headline: Nestlé Q3 Organic Sales Beat Forecasts as It Deconsolidates Russia
summary: Nestlé reported third-quarter organic sales that beat market forecasts and confirmed the deconsolidation of its Russian business operations.
why: Nestlé is the world's largest publicly traded packaged food and beverage conglomerate, serving as a key indicator for global consumer staples demand.

impacts.name: Nestlé SA
impacts.why: Organic sales beating consensus expectations demonstrates resilient pricing power and consumer demand despite macroeconomic pressures.

why_moved: Better-than-expected top-line organic growth figures reassure investors of the company's operational execution and pricing resilience.
